title: String to Integer (atoi)
corePattern: Sequential String Parsing with Overflow Clamping
interviewTips: Clarify spec: leading spaces to skip, optional plus or minus, stop at first non-digit, empty or no-digit returns 0, clamp to 32-bit range.
Trade-off: ad-hoc scan is shortest to code, DFA table is more structured and extensible but same O(n) time and O(1) space.
Edge-case tip: check overflow before multiply using result greater than (INT_MAX - digit) divided by 10 to handle 2147483647 and -2147483648 correctly.

approaches.name: Approach 1: Single Pass Scan with Pre-Overflow Check
approaches.intuition: Read left to right like a human: skip spaces, take optional sign, then accumulate digits until non-digit, clamping if it would exceed 32-bit limits.
approaches.theory: The valid prefix has form spaces* sign? digits*. Once in digits, value is result = result*10+digit. To avoid overflow, test if result > (INT_MAX-digit)/10 before updating. If true, return INT_MAX for positive and INT_MIN for negative. This gives linear scan with constant extra state.

timeComplexity.explanation: Single left-to-right scan over at most n characters, each processed in O(1).

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only indices, sign, and accumulator are stored.

edgeCases: Only spaces or empty string returns 0
Sign without digits like plus-minus-2 returns 0
Stops at first non-digit: 4193 with words returns 4193
Leading zeros: 00000-42a1234 handled as 0 then stop

approaches.name: Approach 2: Deterministic Finite Automaton
approaches.intuition: Model parsing as states: start, signed, in-number, end. Each character type moves the automaton, making control flow table-driven instead of nested ifs.
approaches.theory: Define 4 states q0 start, q1 signed, q2 in-number, q3 end and 4 columns space, sign, digit, other. Transition table is [[0,1,2,3],[3,3,2,3],[3,3,2,3],[3,3,3,3]]. Iterate chars, update state, update sign on entering q1, accumulate with pre-overflow check on staying in q2, break on q3. This is formally equivalent to Approach 1 but separates logic from transitions.

timeComplexity.explanation: One pass over string, table lookup per character in O(1).

spaceComplexity.explanation: Fixed 4x4 transition table plus few integers, independent of n.

steps: start q0, read 4 -> col digit -> q2, ans=4
read space in q2 -> go q3 -> break

edgeCases: Leading spaces stay in q0, spaces after number go to q3 and stop
Second sign in q1 or q2 goes to q3 and stops
Overflow during q2 returns clamped limit immediately
Empty string never leaves q0 returns 0
